query.esql:
SET unmapped_fields = "nullify";
FROM metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_node"
    AND (`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/status_condition` IS NULL OR `metrics.kubernetes.io/node/status_condition` == 1)
    AND (attributes.memory_type == "non-evictable" OR attributes.memory_type IS NULL)
| STATS cpu = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/cpu/allocatable_utilization`),
        mem = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/memory/allocatable_utilization`),
        eph_used = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/ephemeral_storage/used_bytes`),
        eph_total = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/ephemeral_storage/total_bytes`),
        pid_used = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/pid_used`),
        pid_limit = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/pid_limit`),
        status = LAST(attributes.status, @timestamp)
    BY resource.attributes.node_name, resource.attributes.cluster_name, resource.attributes.location, resource.attributes.project_id, attributes.condition
| STATS cpu = MAX(cpu), mem = MAX(mem), eph_used = MAX(eph_used), eph_total = MAX(eph_total), pid_used = MAX(pid_used), pid_limit = MAX(pid_limit),
        ready = MAX(CASE(attributes.condition == "Ready", status, NULL)),
        pressure = MAX(CASE(attributes.condition IN ("MemoryPressure", "DiskPressure", "PIDPressure") AND status == "True", attributes.condition, NULL)),
        problems = COUNT(CASE(attributes.condition != "Ready" AND attributes.condition NOT IN ("KubeletConfigChanged", "SysctlChanged") AND NOT STARTS_WITH(attributes.condition, "Deprecated") AND status == "True", 1, NULL))
    BY resource.attributes.node_name, Cluster = resource.attributes.cluster_name, Location = resource.attributes.location, Project = resource.attributes.project_id
| EVAL Saturation = GREATEST(cpu, mem),
       Ready = COALESCE(ready, "Unknown"),
       Pressure = COALESCE(pressure, "—"),
       `Problem conditions` = problems,
       `CPU %` = 100 * cpu,
       `Memory %` = 100 * mem,
       `Ephemeral storage %` = 100 * eph_used / eph_total,
       `PIDs %` = 100 * pid_used / pid_limit
| KEEP resource.attributes.node_name, Cluster, Location, Project, Saturation, Ready, Pressure, `Problem conditions`, `CPU %`, `Memory %`, `Ephemeral storage %`, `PIDs %`
| SORT Saturation DESC
| LIMIT 100

        status = LAST(attributes.status, @timestamp)
    BY resource.attributes.node_name, resource.attributes.cluster_name, resource.attributes.location, resource.attributes.project_id, attributes.condition
| STATS cpu = MAX(cpu), mem = MAX(mem), eph_used = MAX(eph_used), eph_total = MAX(eph_total), pid_used = MAX(pid_used), pid_limit = MAX(pid_limit),
        ready = MAX(CASE(attributes.condition == "Ready", status, NULL)),
        pressure = MAX(CASE(attributes.condition IN ("MemoryPressure", "DiskPressure", "PIDPressure") AND status == "True", attributes.condition, NULL)),

    BY resource.attributes.node_name, Cluster = resource.attributes.cluster_name, Location = resource.attributes.location, Project = resource.attributes.project_id
| EVAL Saturation = GREATEST(cpu, mem),
       Ready = COALESCE(ready, "Unknown"),
       Pressure = COALESCE(pressure, "—"),
       `Problem conditions` = problems,

       `Memory %` = 100 * mem,

| KEEP resource.attributes.node_name, Cluster, Location, Project, Saturation, Ready, Pressure, `Problem conditions`, `CPU %`, `Memory %`, `Ephemeral storage %`, `PIDs %`
| SORT Saturation DESC
| LIMIT 100

embeddableConfig.description: Nodes worst first by saturation: the higher of average CPU and memory allocatable utilization. Ready, Pressure and Problem conditions use each condition's latest status (`node/status_condition`); Pressure lists an active MemoryPressure, DiskPressure or PIDPressure. Ephemeral storage is used over total boot disk. Click a node name to open its detail or Discover; the row menu (⋮) opens it in the Google Cloud console.
embeddableConfig.title: List of nodes

TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default | WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_node" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend | STATS cpu_util = AVG(RATE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/cpu/core_usage_time`)) / AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/cpu/allocatable_cores`)) BY node = resource.attributes.node_name, bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | SORT bucket ASC, cpu_util DESC, node ASC | LIMIT 10 BY bucket

SET unmapped_fields = "nullify";

embeddableConfig.description: The 10 nodes using the largest share of their allocatable CPU in each time bucket: average CPU used (`node/cpu/core_usage_time` rate) divided by allocatable cores. Sustained values near 100% slow down the pods on that node and leave no room for new ones.
